units.source_text: 名人活像比赛中的饿鬼，闭门不出，陶醉于一决胜负，这样肯定会更加伤害身体。

en.t: The Master was just like a hungry ghost in the midst of the match, shutting himself indoors and losing himself in the struggle to decide victory or defeat; this was sure to damage his health even more.

units.source_text: 名人不是乐天派，总是郁郁不乐。

en.t: The Master was not an optimist; he was always gloomy and unhappy.

units.source_text: 对局时，无论是休息还是离开棋盘，他都只知道沉溺于比赛之中，不出去散步。

en.t: During a match, whether he was resting or had stepped away from the board, he only knew how to sink deeper into the game and would not go out for a walk.
